notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver relative-seasonality package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, activity, and later Q09 correlation; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

For the upcoming calendar month, the EA reconstructs five to ten synchronized prior-year XAU-minus-XAG log returns, rejects epsilon zeros and absolute ties, and follows the centered signed absolute-rank sum with two opposite legs.

The package splits one RISK_FIXED budget equally by frozen per-leg ATR stop risk and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit.
